faq_items.q: How long does order shipping take?
faq_items.a: Domestic shipments take 1 to 3 business days. International express deliveries take between 4 to 7 business days.

faq_items.q: How do you ensure authenticity and quality?
faq_items.a: All our apparel pieces and archive drops are crafted under premium textile standards with heavy cotton fabrics and luxury tailoring.

faq_items.q: How can I track my order status?
faq_items.a: After purchasing, visit 'My Orders' inside your profile to view live status updates (PENDING, PAID, SHIPPED).
We support Credit/Debit Cards, PayPal, and direct bank wire transfers.

faq_items.q: How do I setup 2FA security on my account?
faq_items.a: Navigate to 'My Profile' > 'Two-Factor Authentication' to scan your QR code with Google Authenticator or Authy.
